## Subjective

8yo M, no PMH, presents with 3-day h/o right ear pain + fever (location: right ear; quality: sharp, throbbing; severity: 7/10; duration: 3 days; timing: worse at night; modifying factors: minimal relief with acetaminophen). Recent URI sx 1 week ago. Denies hearing loss persisting, no drainage, no facial weakness. SHx: lives with parents.

## Objective

VS: BP 100/68, HR 96, T 100.6°F. Gen: tired-appearing but interactive. HEENT: right TM erythematous and bulging, no perforation, light reflex absent on right; left TM clear; oropharynx unremarkable. Lungs: CTAB.

## Assessment

1. Acute suppurative otitis media, right (H66.001)

## Plan

Started amoxicillin 80mg/kg/day divided BID × 10 days. OTC acetaminophen/ibuprofen alternating PRN pain/fever. Patient family counseled to return for fever lasting >72 hr after starting abx, severe pain, ear drainage, or worsening symptoms. F/u 2 weeks for ear recheck.
